orig.il: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary
and in it shall be the sanctuary
and it shall be a place
have for themselves, for a possession
it shall be for the whole house
on the one side and on the other side of the oblation
thereof shall be after the homer

orig.gloss: and/ you will give a sixth part of
orig.il: and ye shall give the sixth part
And it shall be the prince's part

orig.gloss: and/ you will cleanse from sin
and/ you will make atonement for

orig.il: for himself and for all the people
and according to the meat offering
